description.value:
You've learned to sync your senses with the natural world. Spending at least 1 minute meditating somewhere natural grants you the following for the next hour:

  • You disregard difficult terrain that nature itself creates.
  • You can understand plants within 30 feet of you, which may telepathically share simple thoughts or memories from the past day.
  • You can direct plants within 30 feet to create difficult terrain or perform other GM-approved tasks, with no action required.

You must complete a short or long rest before you can use this feature again.
